groups.defect: The Javadocs for requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() incorrectly describe boolean return values instead of ForbiddenException on denial.
groups.rationale: Both report the same documentation mistake repeated in two void methods; each documentation block needs correction.

groups.defect: Client-removal cleanup can invoke the throwing V2 setPermissionsEnabled implementation and abort deletion, while skipped cleanup in V2-only mode leaves orphaned authorization resources.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same listener-to-V2 dispatch failure at setPermissionsEnabled and missing cleanup. The merged comment must also preserve the second suggestion's distinct V2-only skipped-cleanup case.

groups.defect: getClientsWithPermission returns the "Clients" sentinel as a client ID, misses untyped per-client resources, and fails to represent real client IDs covered by all-clients grants.
groups.rationale: Both report sentinel pollution in the same enumeration. The first additionally reports missing resource types on individual resources, while the second explicitly identifies the need to represent all-clients grants after excluding the sentinel.
